26:137 · 026 Ash-Shuara

إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

Word in this verse: خُلُقُ — (the) custom

English (Sahih International): This is not but the custom of the former peoples,

English (Yusuf Ali): "This is no other than a customary device of the ancients,

وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ

Word in this verse: خُلُقٍ — (of) a moral character

English (Sahih International): And indeed, you are of a great moral character.

English (Yusuf Ali): And thou (standest) on an exalted standard of character.
